title: One Missing Piece for Open-Source Reasoning Models: A Dataset to Mitigate Cold-Starting Short CoT LLMs in RL
venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 6: Industry Track)
authors_zh: Hyungjoo Chae、Dongjin Kang、Jihyuk Kim、Beong-woo Kwak、Sunghyun Park、Haeju Park、Jinyoung Yeo、Moontae Lee、Kyungjae Lee
paper_type_zh: 长链推理轨迹构造与 RLVR 冷启动配方
best_for_zh: 研究长推理轨迹合成、思考预算控制、答案级过滤、SFT 冷启动与 RLVR 数据审计的读者
one_line: A paper-described 100K long-CoT recipe retrieves o1 flow/budget seeds to guide GPT-4o stepwise generation and answer judgment, but the publication's release target remains the literal text LINK and no paper-matched artifact is verified.
Long CoT Collection 以 o1 推理流与思考预算种子检索来引导 GPT-4o 分步生成并进行答案判断；论文声称构造 100K 条数据，但发布位置仍是字面量“LINK”，尚无可核验的论文配套制品。
why: It makes reasoning-flow shape and thought budget explicit construction variables for long-trace SFT before RLVR, while exposing how missing releases and row-level decisions prevent independent audit or reuse.
inclusion_reason: Directly relevant to the rollout/search and construction tracks: the paper converts retrieved o1 flow and thought-budget demonstrations into GPT-4o-authored long reasoning traces, filters them by answer judgment, and studies those traces as an SFT cold start for RLVR.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open reasoning-model builders often obtain long chain-of-thought supervision by distilling outputs from an existing long-reasoning model. That can reproduce a capability, but it also inherits dependence on the teacher's undisclosed training history, output policy, and serving interface. This paper asks whether an ordinary short-CoT model can instead write long traces when it receives a compact description of how a long-reasoning teacher organizes its search.

The data problem is therefore more specific than “make responses longer.” A useful example must pair a question with a coherent reasoning-flow plan, allocate an appropriate thought budget, expand the plan without losing context, reach the reference answer, and remain suitable as supervised initialization before RLVR. The paper describes such a collection at 100K scale, but its publication does not provide a usable artifact URL, so the claimed collection and the publicly auditable data object must be kept separate.

开源推理模型通常通过蒸馏现有长推理模型的输出来获得长链推理监督。这种做法可以复现能力，却也会继承教师模型未公开的训练历史、输出策略与服务接口依赖。本文追问：能否只向普通短 CoT 模型提供长推理教师如何组织搜索的紧凑描述，再由前者写出长推理轨迹。

因此，数据问题不只是“让回答变长”。一条有用样本需要把问题与连贯的推理流规划配对，分配合适的思考预算，在扩写时维持上下文，得到参考答案，并可作为 RLVR 之前的监督初始化。论文描述了一个 100K 规模的集合，但出版版本没有提供可用的制品链接，故必须区分“论文声称的集合”与“公众目前可审计的数据对象”。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central abstraction is a reasoning flow: an ordered sequence of outline-level steps, separate from the prose rationale. For 1,000 Magpie-Reasoning-V1-150K questions, the authors manually collect o1 reasoning-flow summaries from the public o1 web interface and estimate each unobserved thought budget from API completion tokens minus returned-response tokens. These triples—question, flow, budget—form demonstrations rather than final SFT traces.

For each new Magpie question, the pipeline retrieves a demonstration by category overlap and budget similarity. GPT-4o predicts how many outline steps are needed, writes the new flow, and expands it one step at a time while seeing previous rationales, the current outline, and the next outline. It then produces the final solution. A second GPT-4o judgment compares the generated answer span with the reference answer and filters the result. The same outline-count mechanism also creates 100%, 50%, and 25% budget variants.

核心抽象是推理流：它是按顺序排列的提纲级步骤，与展开后的自然语言推理文本相互区分。针对 Magpie-Reasoning-V1-150K 中的 1,000 个问题，作者从公开的 o1 网页界面人工收集推理流摘要，并以 API 的 completion token 总数减去返回回答的 token 数来估计不可观测的思考预算。这些“问题—推理流—预算”三元组充当示范，而不是最终 SFT 轨迹。

对于每个新的 Magpie 问题，流水线按类别重合度和预算相似度检索一个示范。GPT-4o 先预测所需提纲步骤数并生成新推理流，再在看到既有推理、当前提纲和下一提纲的条件下逐步扩写，最后生成完整解答。随后，另一次 GPT-4o 判断把生成答案片段与参考答案比较并执行过滤。同一套提纲数量控制还被用于生成 100%、50% 和 25% 三种预算版本。

title: Method
方法
html:
Both the 1K seed set and the claimed 100K collection stem from Magpie-Reasoning-V1-150K, which selects long examples from reasoning, mathematics, and coding/debugging categories. Magpie main-category matches receive 1 point and each matching subcategory receives 0.2; this domain score is multiplied by a budget-similarity score based on the ratio of the smaller to the larger budget. The paper does not disclose source-row IDs, tie breaking, or an immutable selected-row manifest.

The seed object is (q, S_ref, b_ref): a question, an o1 reasoning-flow outline manually copied from the public o1 web interface, and an estimated count of unobserved o1 thought tokens. For a new question, GPT-4o receives the retrieved demonstration, predicts the number of steps, and generates a new outline sequence. Each rationale step is then conditioned on all earlier generated rationale text plus the current and next outline entries. After the outline is exhausted, GPT-4o generates the final solution and the pipeline concatenates the steps and answer.

Filtering is answer-level and model-judged. The Appendix F prompt gives GPT-4o the problem, generated attempt, and reference solution and asks for a Yes/No correctness decision. The paper reports that filtering leaves 76% as correct-answer predictions. This is not a symbolic verifier and does not separately certify every intermediate step. Generation temperature, candidate multiplicity, retries, random seeds, API snapshots, absolute token cap, and per-row judge outputs are unknown.

Thought-budget control changes the enforced number of outlines to produce 100%, 50%, and 25% versions. The paper reports traces with as many as 30 reasoning steps and 20K thought tokens. Its cross-model budget comparison is heterogeneous: OpenAI hidden tokens are inferred from API usage, R1 text inside think-tag spans is counted with a GPT tokenizer, and local-model text inside thought-tag spans is counted separately.

The downstream SFT study trains Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with LLaMA-Factory on four A100 GPUs: BF16, 3 epochs, learning rate 5e-6, maximum length 8,192, batch size 1, and gradient accumulation 8. A separate GRPO study starts from Qwen-2.5-0.5B-LC, uses 10K integer-answer NuminaMath Olympiad/AMC problems with OpenRLHF and RingAttention on 16 A100 GPUs, and applies length similarity to o1-mini, latex2sympy answer equivalence, and format rewards. Its settings are BF16, 5 epochs, learning rate 5e-7, maximum length 16,384, batch size 64, and 16 samples per prompt.

1K 种子集与论文声称的 100K 集合都源于 Magpie-Reasoning-V1-150K；该上游数据从推理、数学以及代码/调试类别中选取长样本。Magpie 主类别相同记 1 分，每个相同子类别再记 0.2 分，领域分数与按较小预算/较大预算之比构造的预算相似度相乘。论文没有披露源行 ID、并列时的处理规则或不可变的入选行清单。

种子数据对象为 (q, S_ref, b_ref)：问题、从公开的 o1 网页界面人工抄录的推理流提纲，以及估算的 o1 不可观测思考 token 数。面对新问题时，GPT-4o 接收检索到的示范，预测步骤数并生成新的提纲序列。扩写每个推理步骤时，它会看到此前全部推理文本、当前提纲与下一提纲；提纲用尽后再生成最终解答，并把各步与答案拼接起来。

过滤属于答案级模型判断。附录 F 的提示向 GPT-4o 提供问题、生成尝试和参考解答，并要求输出 Yes/No 正确性判断。论文称过滤后有 76% 被预测为答案正确。这不是符号验证器，也不会逐步证明中间推理。生成温度、候选数、重试次数、随机种子、API 快照、绝对 token 上限和逐行判断结果均未披露。

思考预算控制通过约束提纲数量产生 100%、50% 与 25% 三种版本。论文称轨迹最多可达 30 个推理步骤和 20K 个思考 token。跨模型预算比较采用了不同计量面：OpenAI 的隐藏 token 由 API usage 推算，R1 的 think 标签区段由 GPT tokenizer 计数，本地模型的 thought 标签区段则另行统计。

下游 SFT 用 LLaMA-Factory 在 4 张 A100 上训练 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct：BF16、3 个 epoch、学习率 5e-6、最大长度 8,192、batch size 1、梯度累积 8。另一个 GRPO 实验从 Qwen-2.5-0.5B-LC 出发，在 16 张 A100 上以 OpenRLHF 和 RingAttention 训练，使用 10K 个整数答案的 NuminaMath 奥赛/AMC 问题，并采用与 o1-mini 的长度相似度、latex2sympy 答案等价性和格式三种奖励；设置为 BF16、5 个 epoch、学习率 5e-7、最大长度 16,384、batch size 64、每题 16 次采样。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates three different propositions, none of which independently proves data quality. First, an o3-mini A/B/tie judge compares the collection with correct-answer R1 outputs on 100 sampled questions, with answer order randomized. The reported chart favors the collection on reasoning flow while R1 is somewhat stronger on strategy and step correctness; judge identity overlap, sample size, and absence of human calibration limit this evidence. Second, token distributions show that ordinary GPT-4o prompting rarely exceeds 1,000 tokens, whereas flow-guided generation yields much longer traces and a distribution closer to o1-mini.

Third, downstream models improve under the reported setup. On GPQA Diamond, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct rises from 22.7 to 36.4 and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct from 37.6 to 39.9; on MMLU-Pro the corresponding changes are 43.7 to 44.5 and 49.9 to 51.4. MATH500 scores for models trained on the 100%, 50%, and 25% budget variants are 66.6, 60.7, and 57.6. Best-of-N curves improve, especially at larger N, and the 0.5B policy initialized on the collection is reported to obtain 2–3× larger performance gains from RLVR than the base initialization on MATH500 and GPQA. These results support the complete recipe under its experimental conditions; they do not isolate the collection from optimization, reward design, source mixture, or judge errors, and “2–3× gains” is not “2–3× final performance.”

论文检验了三个不同命题，但没有一个能够单独证明数据质量。第一，o3-mini 在随机交换 A/B 顺序后，对 100 个抽样问题上的本集合与“答案正确的 R1 输出”作 A/B/平局判断。图中，本集合在推理流上更受偏好，而 R1 在策略和步骤正确性上略强；同为模型评审、样本仅 100 条且没有人工校准，限制了这项证据。第二，token 分布显示普通 GPT-4o 提示很少超过 1,000 token，而推理流引导能生成更长轨迹，其分布也更接近 o1-mini。

第三，在论文设定下，下游模型有所提升。GPQA Diamond 上，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 从 22.7 提升到 36.4，Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 从 37.6 提升到 39.9；MMLU-Pro 上对应变化为 43.7 到 44.5、49.9 到 51.4。用 100%、50%、25% 预算版本训练的模型在 MATH500 上分别为 66.6、60.7、57.6。Best-of-N 曲线有所改善，尤其在较大 N 时；论文还称，以本集合初始化的 0.5B 策略在 MATH500 和 GPQA 上通过 RLVR 得到的“性能增量”是基础初始化的 2–3 倍。这些结果支持特定实验条件下的整体配方，却无法把贡献从优化器、奖励设计、来源混合或评审误差中单独分离；“增量为 2–3 倍”也不等于“最终性能为 2–3 倍”。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is a data-construction decomposition, not a new verifier or RL algorithm. Instead of asking a short-CoT model for one very long completion, it transfers a teacher's high-level search shape through a retrieved outline and expands that outline locally. Thought budget is represented by outline count and is treated as a controllable data field rather than only an inference setting. This separates question sourcing, teacher-flow acquisition, flow retrieval, trace writing, answer filtering, and downstream use into inspectable conceptual stages.

The boundary matters: o1 still supplies the seed behavior and hidden budget signal; GPT-4o writes and judges the new traces; GRPO, OpenRLHF, RingAttention, latex2sympy, LLaMA-Factory, Magpie, and NuminaMath are inherited components. Because the promised artifacts are not actually linked, the paper contributes a comparatively detailed recipe and prompt appendix, not a verified open 100K data release.

本文贡献是一种数据构造分解，而不是新的验证器或 RL 算法。它不要求短 CoT 模型一次生成超长回答，而是用检索到的提纲传递教师的高层搜索形态，再局部扩写各提纲步骤。思考预算由提纲数量表示，并被当作可控制的数据字段，而不只是推理时参数。于是，问题来源、教师推理流采集、推理流检索、轨迹写作、答案过滤与下游使用被拆成概念上可检查的阶段。

边界同样重要：o1 仍提供种子行为与隐藏预算信号；GPT-4o 负责写作和判断新轨迹；GRPO、OpenRLHF、RingAttention、latex2sympy、LLaMA-Factory、Magpie 与 NuminaMath 都是沿用组件。由于论文承诺的制品实际上没有可用链接，本文贡献的是较为详细的配方与提示附录，而不是已经核验的开放 100K 数据发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest audit limitation is artifact absence. The ACL paper and its metadata end the release claim with the literal word LINK; no paper-authorized code, dataset, model, immutable revision, row schema, split, or hash manifest is available. A Hugging Face organization named Long-CoT-Collection currently exposes no public models or datasets, but the paper does not provide it as a release target, so it is not recorded as an artifact.

Construction is also only partly reproducible. Exact o1 and GPT-4o snapshots, collection dates, generation decoding, candidate count, retry policy, token caps, random seeds, tie breaking, source-row IDs, and item-level retained/rejected judgments are unknown. GPT-4o both generates and filters the data, while answer agreement cannot detect a lucky final answer, an invalid intermediate step, or a plausible but unfaithful rationale. The 100-item o3-mini comparison has no human adjudication or reported judge-error rate.

Budget units are not directly homogeneous across hidden OpenAI token accounting, GPT-tokenized R1 text, and tagged local-model text. The authors themselves report that the 25% constraint can compress too much information into too few outlines and make reasoning confusing. They test only o1 as the reference LRM and use a 0.5B policy for RL because 16 A100 40GB GPUs could not fit a larger long-sequence setup.

Upstream Magpie licensing is named, but rights for o1-derived flow summaries and GPT-4o-generated traces, redistribution terms, decontamination, benchmark overlap, personal/sensitive content screening, and record-level lineage are not documented. Finally, benchmark and RLVR gains are pipeline-level outcomes; they do not establish that every trace is correct or that the collection alone caused the improvement.

最大的审计限制是制品缺失。ACL 论文及其元数据以字面量 LINK 结束发布声明；目前没有论文授权且可用的代码、数据集、模型、不可变版本、行模式、划分或哈希清单。名为 Long-CoT-Collection 的 Hugging Face 组织目前没有公开模型或数据集，但论文没有把它作为发布目标，因此本卡不会把它登记为制品。

构造过程也只能部分复现。准确的 o1 与 GPT-4o 快照、采集日期、生成解码参数、候选数、重试策略、token 上限、随机种子、并列处理、源行 ID，以及逐条保留/拒绝判断均未知。GPT-4o 同时承担生成与过滤；答案一致无法发现碰巧答对、错误的中间步骤或貌似合理但不忠实的推理。100 条 o3-mini 比较也没有人工裁决或评审错误率。

不同预算单位并不直接同质：OpenAI 隐藏 token 来自 usage 推算，R1 文本用 GPT tokenizer 计数，本地模型则统计标签内文本。作者还明确报告，25% 约束可能把过多信息压入过少提纲，使推理变得混乱。参考 LRM 只测试了 o1；RL 阶段受算力所限，只在 16 张 A100 40GB 能容纳的 0.5B 策略上实验。

论文列出了上游 Magpie 许可证，却没有说明 o1 衍生推理流摘要和 GPT-4o 生成轨迹的权利、再分发条款、去污染、基准重合、个人/敏感内容筛查与逐条 lineage。最后，基准和 RLVR 增益是整条流水线的结果，不能证明每条轨迹都正确，也不能证明改进完全由集合本身造成。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout/search/test-time trace data track, this work provides a useful schema for studying search behavior as two linked objects: a compact reasoning-flow plan and its expanded token trace. Researchers can vary outline count, retrieval match, local expansion context, or final-answer filtering while measuring correctness, diversity, length, and failure transitions. A responsible reuse should log the source row, retrieved seed, budget unit, generated flow, every expansion call, final answer, judge result, model/API revision, and random seed.

For the data construction and open-release recipes track, the paper is valuable as a staged recipe and as a negative release-audit case. A reconstruction can compare one-shot long generation with flow-guided expansion, use an independent symbolic or executable answer checker where possible, add sampled process review, and publish accepted and rejected candidates with rights and decontamination records. The unavailable original collection means the present work is best used to design controlled replications, not treated as a drop-in 100K corpus.

对于推理时 rollout／搜索／轨迹数据方向，本文提供了一种研究搜索行为的有用模式：把紧凑的推理流规划与展开后的 token 轨迹视为两个相连的数据对象。研究者可以改变提纲数量、检索匹配、局部扩写上下文或最终答案过滤，并同时测量正确性、多样性、长度和失败转移。负责任的复现应记录源行、检索种子、预算单位、生成推理流、每次扩写调用、最终答案、判断结果、模型/API 版本与随机种子。

对于数据构造与开放发布配方方向，本文既是分阶段配方，也是一个反面的发布审计案例。复现者可以比较一次性长文本生成与推理流引导扩写，在可行时使用独立的符号或可执行答案检查器，加入抽样过程审查，并连同权利与去污染记录发布被接受和被拒绝的候选。由于原始集合不可获取，当前更适合据此设计受控复现，而不应把它当作可直接使用的 100K 语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3 and Appendix A first for the seed triple, retrieval score, generated flow, expanded rationale, and source mixture; then read Appendix F beside Section 3.2.4 to see that the filter is a GPT-4o Yes/No judgment, not an independently calibrated process verifier.
  • Keep four objects separate: the 1K o1-derived seed demonstrations, the claimed 100K full-budget collection, the 50%/25% variants, and the separate 10K NuminaMath prompt set used for GRPO.
  • Interpret “76%” as the share predicted correct after the stated filter, not a human-verified precision estimate and not a 76% benchmark score.
  • Interpret “2–3×” as a ratio of reported RLVR performance gains, not final accuracy and not proof that each constructed rationale is high quality.
  • The paper and ACL record literally say LINK; do not substitute a similarly named organization, paper page, or third-party mirror for an official release.
  • The paper's most informative negative result is that a 25% outline budget can make rationales confusing; longer or shorter is not automatically better.

• 先读第 3 节和附录 A，把握种子三元组、检索分数、生成推理流、扩写轨迹与来源混合；再将附录 F 与第 3.2.4 节对照，确认过滤器是 GPT-4o 的 Yes/No 判断，而非经过独立校准的过程验证器。
  • 严格区分四类对象：1K 个 o1 衍生种子示范、论文声称的 100K 全预算集合、50%/25% 变体，以及 GRPO 另用的 10K 个 NuminaMath 提示。
  • “76%”表示按所述过滤器被预测为正确的比例，不是经人工核验的精度，也不是 76% 的基准分数。
  • “2–3×”指论文所报 RLVR 性能“增量”之比，不是最终准确率，也不能证明每条构造推理都高质量。
  • 论文和 ACL 记录写的确实是字面量 LINK；不要用同名组织、论文页面或第三方镜像替代官方发布。
  • 论文最有信息量的负面结果是 25% 提纲预算可能让推理变得混乱；更长或更短都不自动意味着更好。

A question is paired with a generated outline sequence, stepwise long rationale, and final answer; the paper does not publish a machine-readable row schema for the claimed release.
o1 supplies manually collected seed reasoning-flow outlines and hidden-thought-token budgets; GPT-4o generates new flows, stepwise rationales, and final answers.

Offline retrieval over Magpie domain labels and estimated thought budgets, followed by GPT-4o generation; downstream studies use LLaMA-Factory SFT and a separate OpenRLHF/RingAttention GRPO environment.
